metadata.title: Story 5.1: Sales Invoice Entry, Edit, and Draft Management
metadata.generator: BMAD Story Context Workflow (manual execution via Cascade)

story.iWant: I want to create and edit sales invoices with strict validations and attachments
story.soThat: so that revenue recognition and receivables are accurate and auditable.
story.tasks: - Backend: SalesInvoice and ARInvoiceLine data model (AC: #2, #3, #5, #7, #10, #12) - Implement `SalesInvoice` entity implementing `CompanyScopedEntity` with fields and constraints from tech spec (status enum, totals, VAT, soft delete fields). - Implement `ARInvoiceLine` entity with quantity, unitPrice, VAT rate, revenue account code, and computed totals. - Add Flyway migrations for `sales_invoices` and `ar_invoice_lines`, including unique constraint on `(company_id, customer_id, invoice_number, invoice_date)` and indexes on `(company_id, status, invoice_date)`. - Backend: Validation service for invoice creation and updates (AC: #3, #4, #5, #10, #11) - Implement `SalesInvoiceValidator` to validate leaf-only accounts, positive amounts, VAT header vs. lines, and duplicate prevention. - Return structured field-level error maps for both header and line errors. - Backend: SalesInvoiceService and repository (AC: #1–#7, #10, #12) - Expose methods for draft create/update/delete with creator-only checks and company scoping. - Implement search, filter, and pagination APIs aligned with `/api/v1/sales-invoices` contract. - Integrate autosave semantics (draft save endpoint) and soft delete. - Backend: Import endpoint and batch processing (AC: #9, #10, #12) - Implement `/api/v1/sales-invoices/import` using streaming CSV/Excel parsing, template validation, and atomic batch behavior. - Return detailed error map with row numbers and field names when validation fails. - Backend: Audit logging integration (AC: #7, #8, #12) - Use shared `AuditService` and `AuditLog` entity patterns from Epic 4 to log all invoice mutations and import attempts with deterministic `eventHash` and company scoping. - Frontend: Sales invoice list page (AC: #1, #2, #6, #7, #12) - Implement `SalesInvoices` list view following data-table pattern (search, filter by status/customer/date, pagination, count, refresh). - Surface status badges for DRAFT/PENDING_APPROVAL/POSTED and expose actions to open, edit, or delete drafts. - Frontend: Sales invoice form + line items grid (AC: #1–#6, #11) - Build a form with customer picker, invoice/due dates, reference text, and totals summary. - Implement `InvoiceLineGrid` component with inline validation, VAT calculation, and leaf-only account picker reusing COA UI patterns. - Implement autosave with undo/redo for at least the last 10 edits. - Frontend: Attachments UI (AC: #8) - Reuse attachment dropzone and preview components established in Epic 3/4 stories, wired to `/api/v1/sales-invoices/{id}/attachments` endpoints. - Frontend: Import dialog (AC: #9) - Create import modal for uploading CSV/Excel, showing progress and error map results. - Testing: Backend and frontend coverage (AC: #1–#12) - Add unit tests for validation rules (customer selection, account leaf enforcement, VAT totals, duplicate detection). - Add integration tests for invoice create/update/delete/import and audit logging. - Add component and E2E tests for core UI flows (basic create, autosave, attachment upload, import with errors).

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: (AC23-001) Invoice form provides a typeahead/searchable dropdown to select an existing customer; "Add New Customer" is not available. When a customer is selected, the form displays the customer tax code and address in read-only fields pulled from master data. (AC23-002) On save, the system auto-generates an invoice number with format `INV-{YYYY}-{seq}` where the sequence increments per customer per calendar year; duplicate `(customerID, invoiceNumber, invoiceDate)` combinations are blocked. (AC23-003) Line items support one or more rows with description, quantity > 0, unitPrice > 0, VAT% (0, 5, 10, EXEMPT), revenue account (leaf-only), and optional item/service; system computes line totals and VAT per tech spec. (AC23-004) Revenue account selection enforces leaf-only accounts; non-postable/parent accounts from `chart_of_accounts` are rejected with inline error and prevent save. (AC23-005) Header totals are computed in real time; header VAT must match sum of line VAT within ±1 VND tolerance; mismatches beyond tolerance block save/post. (AC23-006) User can save a draft invoice at any time even if required fields are incomplete; autosave runs every 30 seconds; undo/redo stack keeps at least the last 10 edits client-side. (AC23-007) Only the invoice creator or an Admin can edit or delete drafts; other users receive HTTP 403 with message "Insufficient permissions"; delete is soft-delete via `isDeleted` and `deletedAt`. (AC23-008) Invoice form supports file attachments via drag-and-drop or file picker with allowed types {pdf, xlsx, xls, jpg, png, jpeg}, max 5MB/file and 20MB/invoice; attachments editable only in draft and audit-logged. (AC23-009) `/api/v1/sales-invoices/import` accepts multipart CSV/Excel files using the documented template; validates headers and up to 1000 rows; any row failure rejects the entire batch and returns an error map `(rowNumber, field, message)`. (AC23-010) The system prevents creating an invoice if `(customerID, invoiceNumber, invoiceDate)` already exists with `isDeleted = false`, returning HTTP 409 with descriptive message; duplicate checks are consistent across UI, import, and API. (AC23-011) Inline validation provides immediate feedback as the user types; negative values and missing required fields show inline errors; save button disabled while any validation error is present for required fields. (AC23-012) Every invoice create, edit, and delete attempt logs an immutable audit record including before/after snapshots, actor, timestamp, device IP, user agent, and deterministic `eventHash = SHA256(...)`.

story-context.constraints: - Multi-tenancy: All AR entities, including `SalesInvoice` and `ARInvoiceLine`, must implement `CompanyScopedEntity` and be filtered by `company_id` in repositories and services, consistent with `CompanyContext` and data architecture. - RBAC and security: Endpoints under `/api/v1/sales-invoices` must enforce JWT authentication and RBAC roles (Admin, Accountant, Chief Accountant, CFO). Only creator or Admin may edit/delete drafts; approval endpoints restricted to Chief Accountant as per FR26 for follow-on stories. - Endpoint placement: Controllers for this story live under `backend/src/main/java/com/accounting/controller/sales/` and expose `/api/v1/sales-invoices` and related endpoints, consistent with epic-to-architecture mapping. - Validation alignment: Posting and validation rules (leaf-only accounts, open period checks, double-entry invariants) must align with Voucher Engine services (`VoucherValidationServiceImpl`, `VoucherPostingServiceImpl`) to keep AR behavior consistent with GL. - Audit trail: All invoice lifecycle events (create/edit/delete/import/post/approval in later stories) must be logged via `AuditService` to `AuditLog` with company scoping and chain hashing, reusing patterns from Story 4.7. - Frontend structure: Implement feature-first pages under `frontend/src/features/accounting/pages/SalesInvoices/` and shared AR components (line grid, import dialog, attachments) under appropriate shared component namespaces (`components/ar/`, `components/account/`, `components/common/`). - API contracts: Follow standard response envelope `{ data, meta, error }` and status codes (`400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, `403 INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSION`, `409` for duplicates), consistent with tech spec and existing PurchaseBill APIs.
